scope: Source-only static distribution closure, including original full UI, subapps, inline/compressed configuration, and declared lazy chunks. Factory services remain external.
limitations: Values supplied only by a live backend, user files, arbitrary device payloads, and runtime-only branches cannot be exhaustively enumerated by static analysis.
Unresolved expressions are retained as review evidence; this audit does not execute manufacturer JavaScript.
excludedCategories: Desktop renderer updates and explicitly opened native-system repair tools
